aliases: cuet ug common university entrance test undergraduate

domains.name: Section II: Domain-Specific Subjects (27 subjects from Class 12 syllabus)
Section III: General Test (Numerical Ability, Quantitative Reasoning, GK, Current Affairs)

exam_name: CUET UG (Common University Entrance Test — Undergraduate)
exam_price_notes: ₹700–₹1,500 depending on number of subject papers chosen; ₹350–₹700 for SC/ST/PwBD
exam_rules: Computer Based Test (CBT) for most exams (NEET UG is pen-and-paper OMR). No calculators, mobile phones, or study materials. Negative marking: -1 mark per wrong answer (NEET, JEE), -1 mark (CUET), -1 mark (UGC-NET).
id_requirements: Admit card + valid government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar preferred; Passport, Driving Licence also accepted)

prerequisites.description: Class 12 or equivalent; no age limit

retake_policy.notes: JEE Main is held twice a year; NEET once a year; UGC-NET twice a year; CUET once a year
